overview: The commission approved several one-day licenses for community events and a new wine and malt license for a restaurant in Medford Square. The meeting concluded with a policy discussion regarding the administrative coordination of restaurant operating hours between different city departments.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission tabled the approval of the previous meeting's minutes to the next session.

items.title: One-Day License: Chef Jason's Catered Events
items.summary: Approved a one-day wine and malt license for a private event at the Medford Library.

items.title: Management Change: Ocean State Job Lot
items.summary: The commission skipped this item because no representative was present to testify regarding the application.

items.title: One-Day Licenses: Arts Collaborative Medford
items.summary: Approved three one-day licenses for events on March 2, 6, and 19, including an all-alcohol license for a Mardi Gras celebration.

items.title: New Wine and Malt License: Buns House
items.summary: Approved a new wine and malt license for Frozen Boston, Inc., doing business as Buns House, at the former Chili Garden location at 41 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Entertainment License: Buns House
items.summary: Approved an entertainment license for Buns House to operate two televisions on the premises.

items.title: General Business and Policy Discussion
items.summary: The commission discussed plans for a quarterly newsletter to licensees and explored streamlining the process for common victualler permits to align operating hours with liquor service regulations.
